notes:
- **Quick capture is its own page.** The side column's menu is now three rows, **Home**, **Quick capture** and **Settings**, and a row only ever changes what the window shows: nothing in the menu takes a picture any more. The six one-click items that sat under a small grey heading (where **Full screen** took a picture the moment you clicked it) are gone from the column.
- **Seven tiles, each with a picture.** The **Quick capture** page shows Region, Window, Full screen, Scrolling, Record video, Copy text and Secure capture as tiles, four across, each with a small drawing of what it takes, its keys (your own hotkeys) and one line about it. A click, **Enter** or **Space** starts that mode exactly as its keys do; the arrow keys only move the focus. Without Pro, the four Pro tiles carry a **PRO** badge and open the Pro sheet for that feature, and a row under the tiles offers **Get Pro, $14.99**. **Open recent captures** (the strip) and its hotkey moved there too. The **?** button and F1 open Take a screenshot in the manual.
- **The Pro sheet opens where you are.** Choosing a Pro feature without Pro (a tile, a hotkey, the tray) now puts the sheet over the page the window is showing, instead of sending the window back to Home first.
- The Copy text how-to, the manual (Home window, Pro features, Take a screenshot) and the README no longer say a mode is "in Quick capture" in the side column.
